<div class="card-body">
'''Captain Khurgee''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊カーギー大尉</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに、2フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキの中から「探査部隊」を1枚探しだし、手札に加えることができる。その後デッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの位置に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Captain-Khurgee-PSA-157709591.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ドッキング・ベイの保安士官で、リーダー。スター・デストロイヤー・サンダーフレアに乗り込み、シャトル事故の現場から5人の士官を救い出した勇敢な人物として知られる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Captain Khurgee.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, you may use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Scanning Crew and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
A docking-bay security officer and leader. Known as a brave man who went aboard the Star Destroyer Thunderflare and rescued five officers from a shuttle crash.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is カーギー大尉. Scanning Crew is 「探査部隊」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Khurgee]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
